item.title: Where to Buy Tickets to 2026 ACM Awards With Shania Twain, Kacey Musgraves & More
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey there, country music fans. The 61st Academy of Country Music Awards are just around the corner, and we're excited to share all the details with you. The awards ceremony is set to take place on Sunday, May 17th, 2026, at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas, and will be hosted by the one and only Shania Twain.
[Short music transition]
Host: "This year's nominees are a star-studded bunch, featuring names like Luke Combs, Chris Stapleton, Morgan Wallen, and Miranda Lambert, just to name a few. And for the second year in a row, female solo acts are leading the nominations, with Megan Moroney topping the list with nine nods.
[Short music transition]
Host: "If you're looking to attend the show in person, tickets are available for purchase through AXS.com, with prices starting at around $131.41 for upper sections. And if you're looking to stream the show from the comfort of your own home, you can catch it live exclusively on Prime Video, Twitch, and Amazon Music at 8 p.m. ET.
[Short music transition]
Host: "Some of the categories to keep an eye out for include Entertainer of the Year, with nominees like Lainey Wilson, Morgan Wallen, and Jelly Roll going head-to-head. And in the Song of the Year field, you'll see fierce competition from Megan Moroney, Miranda Lambert, and more.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for now, folks. Don't forget to tune in to the 61st Academy of Country Music Awards on May 17th, and check out our website for more information on nominees and ticket availability. Thanks for listening, and we'll catch you on the next one."
